{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Showcase Hub

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_hub spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Colored destination signs."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- The book, supplies and furnace."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Showcase Hub

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- A glass roof and blue sky."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Fly in Creative here; your previous game mode returns outside."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Leave iron smelting, take a trip, then return: it keeps cooking."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Showcase Hub

"}, {"text": "Try it
", "extra": [{"text": "For live performance, open World tools, then Dimension monitoring. Open dashboard shows the browser view.

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prismatic Meadow

"}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Explore a pastel countryside of flowers, open meadows and cherry trees."}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_meadow spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Mint grass, teal leaves and lavender water."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prismatic Meadow

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Pink clouds and a large, warm-colored sun."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Birch pavilions; pink roofs in cherry groves."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- The afternoon repeats instead of reaching night."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prismatic Meadow

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Biomes and pavilion locations use this world's own seed."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Fly above Y=224 to return to the hub, with passengers."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Try it
", "extra": [{"text": "While in this meadow, try its high-altitude return.
", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare sky return", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tp @s ~ 230 ~"}}]}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Crimson Nightmare

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_nightmare spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Red grass, black leaves and violet water."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Crimson Nightmare

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- A purple sky and huge red sun."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Green clouds and thick green fog."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Afternoon stays still; no moon or stars appear."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Listen for Nether music in a jungle."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Long-Day Wilderness

"}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Roam an ordinary-looking wilderness where daylight lasts much longer."}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_long_day spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- A wooden observation deck."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Long-Day Wilderness

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Sheep, rabbits and farm animals."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Slow-moving daylight."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Day lasts 30 minutes; night lasts 5. Game speed stays normal."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Sheep are favored. Spawn limits have been increased."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Long-Day Wilderness

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Rabbits may appear; new hostile mobs are disabled. Normal spawn conditions still apply."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Separate terrain and weather; no natural lightning."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Frost Garden

"}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "A lodge shelters you from a cold, snowy night. Take food and armor outside."}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_frost spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- A roofed lodge and an open-air deck."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Snow falling onto the exposed ground."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Frost Garden

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Compare health and movement outside, under the roof, and in armor."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Survival mode: exposed snowfall slows you and hurts every 2 seconds."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Frost Garden

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Boots reduce cold damage by 25%; leggings reduce it by 50%. Only the stronger bonus applies."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- A chestplate blocks this cold and new Slowness. Old Slowness wears off."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Frost Garden

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Shelter stops new exposure. Sleeping ends neither the snow nor this paused night."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Snow builds up; exposed water does not form new ice."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Lantern Cavern

"}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Explore a closed cavern with glowing gardens below and hanging ruins above."}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Prepare travel", "color": "blue", "underlined": true, "insertion": "justepicdimensions:showcase_guide", "clickEvent": {"action": "suggest_command", "value": "/tpj justepicdimensions:showcase_cavern spawn"}}, {"text": "

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Mossy slopes, planted gardens and pools."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Lantern Cavern

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Glowing berry vines and hanging lantern ruins."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Bright gardens and shadowed stone."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- The bed saves your spawn without skipping night."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Lantern Cavern

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Lush caves below Y=80; dripstone above. No sunlight reaches this world."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Below Y=-4, return to the hub at 8:1 coordinate scaling. You may land away from its platform."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Lantern Cavern

"}, {"text": "Try it
", "extra": [{"text": "Try the return by moving below this cavern's floor.

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Loadout Arena

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- A raised sandstone shelter. Pressure plate exit, button enter. Stairs to arena floor."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Carry a hub tripwire-hook key to enter. It is not used up."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Starter weapons, armor, food and tools."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Loadout Arena

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Zombies, skeletons and spiders outside."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Gear, XP, health, food and effects are saved apart from your previous world."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Loadout Arena

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Change gear and stats; leave, then return to compare. Your previous state waits outside."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Start at level 5 with two golden hearts. Red health is capped at ten hearts."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Loadout Arena

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Natural monster limits: 18 loaded, or 8 within 48 blocks of you."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Create a private arena with its own saved gear and stats."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Loadout Arena

"}, {"text": "Try it
", "extra": [{"text": "Leave the private run by its return route.

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- Keep your ordinary inventory. Carry mined resources home."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- After everyone leaves, 30 idle seconds trigger a reset. Active work can delay it."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

"}]}, {"text": "What to look for

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Pillarless End

"}, {"text": "What to look for
", "extra": [{"text": "- Purple haze around the island."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Watch from above in Creative flight."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- A separate seed and dragon fight leave your normal End untouched."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

{"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "Pillarless End

"}, {"text": "Other features
", "extra": [{"text": "- After victory, place four End crystals around the exit fountain. Summon the dragon again: pillars stay absent."}, {"text": "
"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- The exit portal follows normal End-return rules. Use the hub link for a direct return."}, {"text": ""}]}]}

"}]}, {"text": "", "extra": [{"text": "- Place a marker; compare another team's private arena."}, {"text": ""}]}]}
